gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-addons/versions: lists each AI add-on version seen on endpoints with its admission-scan verdict for that exact content digest (not yet scanned is never clear)
gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-addons/sightings: lists each add-on version per endpoint and detection source, with first/last seen, risk flags and secret types (never a value)
gaps.GET /v1/endpoint-addons/flagged: lists the endpoint add-on sightings flagged at or above a severity (the removal-directive and detection contract)
